name: The Emotional Trojan
description: HR email: 'Due to the passing of a colleague, we are collecting funds. See attached PDF'. The employee does not exist in the database. SPF/DKIM fail. PDF contains JavaScript that steals browser session tokens. 12 hosts compromised.

artifacts.description: Email from hr@corp.com: 'Condolences - Fund for Juan Pérez's family'. SPF: fail. DKIM: fail.

metadata.subject: Condolencias - Fondo para familia de Juan Pérez

artifacts.description: Attached PDF: embedded JavaScript that accesses session cookies (session_id, auth_token, csrf) and sends them to an external domain.
HTTPS connection to family-support[.]org from 12 internal hosts within 30 minutes of mass PDF opening.
Verification: real HR did not send the email. 'Juan Pérez' does not exist in the active personnel database.

peirce_chain.firstness: Condolence email with donation PDF from HR.
peirce_chain.secondness: Employee does not exist. SPF/DKIM fail. PDF steals tokens. 12 hosts compromised.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Habit of using social taboo (death) to nullify technical distrust protocols.

notes: Eco: the sign of death is the ultimate semantic barrier.
